title: Zakat & Waqf Management
thesis: Snowflake optimizes zakat impact — Dynamic Tables maintain real-time collection and distribution ledgers, ML.FORECAST projects seasonal patterns, and Cortex AI measures beneficiary outcomes and generates donor impact reports

talking_points: Rp 21 trillion collected from 2 million muzakki — 23% growth year-on-year.
Digital channels now 64% of total collection — mobile apps driving growth.
Ramadan contributed 38% of annual collection — Rp 8 trillion in 30 days.
show: Point at Rp 21T collection and 23% growth
tabs.call_out: Rp 21T collected — digital at 64%, Ramadan spike 38% of annual total

transition.line: Let's look at distribution and impact.

talking_points: 500,000 mustahik served across 34 provinces — 8 asnaf categories.
Economic empowerment programs: 23% poverty graduation rate within 2 years.
Geographic gap: 5 eastern provinces below 60% distribution coverage.
tabs.call_out: 23% poverty graduation — but 5 provinces below 60% coverage

transition.line: Impact is strong but uneven. Let's see predictions.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST projects Rp 26T collection next year if digital growth continues.
Seasonal model enables precise Ramadan surge planning — resource allocation 4 weeks ahead.
